mcp_builtin_description: These services start with the local daemon. Each task receives an isolated context and provider authorization; no external URL or command is required.
mcp_builtin_decision_hint: Provides semantic decision validation and completion checks through the daemon broker. Tasks use the configured Jev provider only when decision capability is enabled.
mcp_builtin_identity_hint: The daemon broker is always available, but email and other identity calls require explicit task capability authorization.
mcp_builtin_email_hint: Send and read the Agent identity mailbox through daemon-managed services.
mcp_builtin_phone_hint: Place, inspect and cancel outbound calls through a configured daemon phone provider.
